summary: The .NET SDK lacks retry logic for schedule updates when the server returns a 'mismatched conflict token' error, which the server now requires as of a recent change.
userImpact: Users cannot successfully update schedules when conflict token mismatches occur, as the SDK lacks the required retry logic.
rootCause: The Temporal server now returns 'mismatched conflict token' errors for schedule updates, but the .NET SDK (and other SDKs) don't implement retry logic to handle this.
proposedFix: Implement retry logic for schedule updates that fetches the latest schedule and retries with the updated conflict token when a mismatch occurs.
keyQuote: No SDK passes or retries on the conflict token for schedule updates. The server returns 'mismatched conflict token' as of https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/pull/8474.
